headline: Airlines Urge US CDC to Reconsider Ebola Travel Declaration Rules
summary: Airline industry associations called on the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention to reconsider passenger declaration requirements regarding Ebola.
why: Health declaration rules impose operational and compliance burdens on international airlines serving global routes into the United States.

entities.name: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

impacts.name: Airlines
impacts.why: Lobbying efforts seek to reduce compliance overhead and check-in friction for international carriers.
